profile: Science and technology laboratory designer. Books work by who signed the contract, so a containment suite built inside a fence line is filed under the pharma client who paid for it. Holds the sole R4 match.

projects.title: National Materials Laboratory
projects.narrative: Materials research laboratory on an army installation, with high-bay test halls and a shielded metrology wing.

projects.title: Range Instrumentation Facility
projects.narrative: Instrumentation and data reduction facility supporting an active test range, with range control and telemetry rooms.

projects.title: Naval Propulsion Test Cell
projects.narrative: Propulsion test cell and control building at a naval installation, with blast venting and acoustic attenuation.

projects.title: Whitmore Life Sciences Building
projects.narrative: Life sciences building with BSL-2 teaching labs, a vivarium and a shared imaging core.

projects.title: Meridian Vaccine Fill-Finish Suite
projects.narrative: Sterile fill-finish suite with a restricted access barrier system, a gowning cascade and effluent decontamination, commissioned to a validated pressure regime.

projects.title: Calder Public Health Laboratory
projects.narrative: Public health laboratory with BSL-3 suites, an autoclave corridor and a sample reception hall.

projects.title: Federal Forensics Laboratory
projects.narrative: Forensic laboratory with evidence handling, trace analysis and a firearms examination suite.

projects.title: Semiconductor Metrology Fit-out
projects.narrative: Metrology and failure-analysis fit-out with vibration-isolated slabs and a class-controlled entry lobby.

projects.title: Army Reserve Readiness Centre
projects.narrative: Readiness centre with assembly hall, simulator bays and vehicle maintenance for a reserve garrison.

projects.title: Restricted Laboratory Programme
projects.client: withheld under a programme access agreement
projects.narrative: Laboratory programme delivered inside a closed area; the client, the location and the research mission are not disclosable to a third party.
